title: Staff-Level SoC Verification Strategy Review
description: Create and review a staff-level SoC verification strategy covering VIP reuse, coverage, formal/liveness, debug triage, regression gates, and signoff risks.

steps.title: Step 1: Define Strategy Boundaries
steps.instructions: Open `strategy_template.md` and split responsibilities across block, subsystem, SoC, firmware, and formal owners.

steps.title: Step 2: Build the Coverage and Liveness Plan
steps.instructions: Fill in measurable system coverage goals plus formal/liveness properties with trigger, obligation, failure meaning, and owner.

steps.title: Step 3: Add Debug, Regression, and Risks
steps.instructions: Define the failure evidence package, bucketing workflow, smoke/nightly/stress/signoff suites, and risk register.

steps.title: Step 4: Peer Review Against the Rubric
steps.instructions: Score the plan with the rubric, then compare against `model_solution.md` to identify missing staff-level reasoning.
